title: Concept: Script loaded over plaintext HTTP in html — review required
description: In html, executable code is requested over plaintext. Script has full access to the document, so an injected response can read tokens, rewrite the page and exfiltrate data. Mixed-content blocking helps on HTTPS pages, but the tag still fails closed and older or non-browser consumers do not block it.
applicability: html templates that include third-party scripts.
risk: Script substitution during transit; MEDIUM severity.
